home.title: How big a TFI Banisa are you?
home.subtitle: One Telugu movie a day. Five clues. Six guesses. Keep your streak alive and top the leaderboard.
home.step1: Start with one clue: the release year.
home.step2: Each wrong guess unlocks a new clue: music director, director, emoji story, lead actors.
home.step3: Guess in as few tries as you can and share your score on WhatsApp.
